what: Ticket text, filed as a row because this cloud session has no tracker. Title: P16's p33 real isolation law times out under load in next/. Body: next/apps/fabrika/src/instance-one-file.integration.test.ts line 708, p33 real isolation, timed out at 60 s in a 38-file next-integration shard (run 44416548062) and passes in 11 to 15 s alone or on main's own leg. Decision 0036 asks a flaky test to be fixed the day it is seen. Find what it waits on that grows with load, and check whether its inline sealed program's { type: "read" } step is a stale Msg after decision 0569. Finding row: field/findings/2026-11-18-p33-isolation-times-out-under-load.json.
cause: The law's pass depends on runner load, and the 0602 split runs it only on main's full run, so its time under other shard splits was never seen.
fix: Make the law wait on the event its work ends with rather than on the run being quick, as decision 0609 asks, and settle the read step's Msg key.
test: The law passes in a 38-file shard, run a few times with no fail-fast.
